headline: Aligner volume grows and profitability improves
summary_short: Revenue rose 1.9% to $1,014.8M with Clear Aligner volume up 6.6%, and non-GAAP EPS grew 7% to $2.80. Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to $1,000M-$1,020M.
summary_long: Non-GAAP gross margin was flat at 70.4% and non-GAAP operating margin rose to 24.4%. Scanner placements topped 157,000 systems. Align repurchased about 627 thousand shares and plans up to $300M of repurchases in the fourth quarter. The company also announced a CEO succession plan separately, with Jennifer Davis taking over on December 31, 2026.
confidence_notes: Non-GAAP figures exclude items shown in the company's reconciliation tables. GAAP EPS delta computed from $1.90 versus $0.78. The CEO succession news came in a separate release the same day.

drivers.explanation: Record doctor submitters, record third-quarter shipments, improved utilization and broad international growth; North America orthodontist shipments rose for the first time in six quarters.
Disciplined expense management and productivity improvements, despite gross margin below expectations on fuel-related transportation costs, lower aligner prices and mix.
The CFO cites a softer environment for discretionary healthcare spending and capital equipment investment.
CFO says 2027 planning assumes revenue growth and margin expansion without requiring a consumer recovery.
